exposure: Surgical approach (single-port vs. multiport laparoscopic hysterectomy)
cohort: 256 women scheduled for laparoscopic hysterectomy for symptomatic myoma and/or adenomyosis from 8 tertiary teaching hospitals in Korea
finding: Single-port laparoscopic hysterectomy was not inferior to multiport laparoscopic hysterectomy in terms of conversion and/or complication rates, but did not offer any advantages in terms of pain or cosmetic outcomes.
